claim.value: Missing prerequisites require an unresolved test classification.
claim.scope: Classification of baseline and reduced-configuration tests; prerequisites are not enumerated.

provenance.rationale: P015 explicitly makes missing prerequisites a trigger for unresolved classification.

signal_basis.value: Baseline and reduced configurations use the same predeclared repetition rule; missing prerequisites trigger an unresolved outcome in the test record.
signal_basis.scope: Classification of tested configurations, without asserting that prerequisites are actually missing.

provenance.rationale: P015 supplies the classification rule and its applicability; P017 supplies the recording of reproduced, non-reproduced and unresolved outcomes.
The claim is a supported procedural classification rule, requiring no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: The claim expresses the mapping's explicit rule for withholding a determinate test outcome when prerequisites are missing. It makes no causal or effectiveness inference. Assuming prerequisites are satisfied leaves this conditional rule untriggered, rather than invalidating it.
uncertainty: Prerequisites are not enumerated, so the packet does not determine which concrete omissions would trigger the rule; this does not undermine the stated classification requirement.
